newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down, Pakistan buy reported.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down, Pakistan buy reported.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were down at midday with an unconfirmed sale of SMR20 to Pakistan being the only business reported.
An official trade source said 1,500 tonnes of SMR20 for July shipment was traded to Karachi 258 cents a kg. But market dealers could not confirm this.
"I have not heard of it, but it could be true as the market is looking at 258/259 for SMR20," said a dealer.
At noon, July RSS 1 buyer was officially quoted at 283 cents ($1.13) a kg, down one cent from Friday's close. July SMR 20 buyer also fell a cent to 262.
A checking with trading houses at noon showed the SMR 20 offered at 258/259 cents, SMR CV at 330, SMR L at 307, SMR 10 at 261 and drum latex at 226.
A Malaysian-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU container.
